title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Dr. Havva Guney-Ruebenacker is a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School where she teaches Comparative Family Law. She specializes in American family law, Islamic law and comparative law, and works as a consultant and expert witness in divorce litigation matters involving spousal support, marital property and child custody issues.
